Subscriptions and billing

Calxo offers a paid subscription (“Calxo Premium”) that unlocks the app’s features. The subscription automatically renews and your payment method is charged at the then-current price until you cancel.

Calxo may offer a free trial. Its length and the price that follows it are shown in the app before you subscribe. If you do not cancel before the trial ends, the subscription renews automatically and your payment method is charged.

Referral rewards

Calxo may offer a referral program. You get a personal referral code to share. When someone who is new to Calxo signs up, enters your code, and then makes their first paid subscription purchase, you earn one free month of Calxo Premium. The person who uses your code does not receive a discount or a reward.

Free months are granted as promotional access and have no cash value. They are not transferable, cannot be sold or exchanged, and are added when your current paid plan ends rather than extending it — a free month never runs at the same time as a subscription you are paying for. A free month does not change, pause, or cancel a subscription: your paid plan continues to renew unless you cancel it in your app store settings.

Rewards are earned only on genuine purchases. We may withhold or reverse a reward, and may suspend or end the program or your participation in it, if a purchase is refunded or charged back, if a code is used for self-referral or shared through spam or paid advertising, or if we reasonably believe the program is being abused. We may change or end the referral program at any time; months you have already been granted are not taken back except in the cases above.

Health and nutrition disclaimer

Calxo is a tracking and informational tool, not a medical device and not a provider of medical, nutritional, or professional advice. The calorie, macro, and other figures it shows are estimates.

Do not rely on Calxo for medical decisions. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before making changes to your diet, exercise, fasting, or health routine — especially if you are pregnant or nursing, under 18, or have a medical condition or history of disordered eating.

AI features and accuracy

Calxo’s AI features estimate nutrition from photos and descriptions and generate coaching replies. These outputs can be inaccurate or incomplete. Use your own judgment and verify important information.
